plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.5.97 or AE 1.6.1170
plugin.description: For Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 and Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 3.7.0, which reads Address Library formats 1 and 2.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.99 / 1.7.104 (current Steam version)
plugin.description: For Skyrim 1.7.99 and 1.7.104. Needs SKSE 2.3.x and Address Library All-in-One v13 or newer. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 7.2.0; this DLL is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later (licence texts install with it).

plugin.name: Normal
plugin.description: Step dodges travel their full distance: forward about 409 units, back 300, to the side about 251.

plugin.name: Shorter
plugin.description: Shorter step dodges: forward 70% (about 287 units), back 60% (180), to the side 80% (about 201); the diagonals by the same mix. The standard roll uses the same distances, so it is shorter too; the long roll is not changed. Run Nemesis or Pandora after installing.
